from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """
    Represents a single judgment document found in the collection.
    Captures the document's identifier and the specific legal cause/charge found within its text,
    which allows the inference agent to map it to the target classification categories.
    """
    title: str = Field(description="The document's title, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_cause: str = Field(description="The primary legal cause, charge, or administrative action mentioned in the document (e.g., 'Intentional Injury', 'Fraud', 'Land Registration')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
